why_ai: Simulated phishing and training modules are software and content that AI generates and personalizes.
why_clarity: Click rates recur constantly, but nobody links them to real compromise.
why_digital: Email simulations and online modules delivered entirely through SaaS.

why_ai: Calibrating difficulty from response data already collected is a psychometric modelling task.
why_clarity: Item-response methods make difficulty a measurable property across many campaigns.
why_digital: Simulation response data in, calibrated difficulty scores out.

why_ai: Joining gateway, incident and report data is analytics, though causal attribution needs care.
why_clarity: Real compromises are rare and slow, so whether training worked is hard to check.
why_digital: Email gateway logs and incident records in, outcome analysis out.

why_ai: Delivery and tracking are solved, and LLMs now write convincing lures at scale.
why_clarity: Clicks are recorded instantly, but their meaning depends on vendor-set difficulty.
why_digital: Simulated emails sent, clicks tracked and reported online.

why_ai: Enrolment, reminders and evidence packages are already largely automated through HR integrations.
why_clarity: Completion tracking and audit evidence are exact, checkable administrative outputs.
why_digital: HR system data in, assignments and compliance reports out.

why_ai: Most reported messages are mechanically resolvable, which email classifiers handle.
why_clarity: Each report is benign or malicious, resolved quickly against message analysis.
why_digital: Reported emails in, triage verdicts out.

why_ai: Exposure is observable from systems data, so targeting can be computed.
why_clarity: Whether tailored training reduces real risk lacks an agreed, timely measure.
why_digital: Role and access data in, tailored assignments out.

why_ai: Whether to deceive employees is a governance and ethics question settled with HR and works councils.
why_clarity: Harm is not measured by anyone and acceptable deception is contested.
why_digital: Policy and campaign records, decided through negotiation with employee representatives.

why_ai: Operations automate, but holding colleagues' trust while testing them stays human.
why_clarity: Campaign tasks recur, but programme success has no accepted measure.
why_digital: Dashboard work in-house, with handling complaints and relationships across the business.

why_ai: Treating a click as a fairness matter is an HR design question, not automatable work.
why_clarity: Whether a click reflects the person or the message has no agreed answer.
why_digital: Click records and assignments handled in systems the employee cannot see.

why_ai: Security modules are generic content that generative AI produces and localizes cheaply.
why_clarity: Completion is recorded, but behaviour change is unmeasured.
why_digital: Online modules assigned, completed and tracked digitally.
